Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until further details (including the composition, shape, appearance and position of the band) including sectional drawings  at a scale of no more than 1:20 and samples of materials of the approved works to the listed boundary wall and filter bed have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a method statement of brick and tile refurbishment (including a management and repair regime for the future) detailing the materials removed and the substructure has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of the sections of the southern wall to be removed, and the proposed materials finishes, have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise agreed beforehand by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until detailed drawings of the rooflights, doors on the northern elevation and internal openings within the gatehouse building, have been submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The plans shall detail the proposed works and the materials for construction. The details shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise agreed by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations relating to the refurbishment of the existing Gate House and southern boundary wall and removal of part of the southern filterbed bank, construction of the "Mews" building and associated facilities and landsaping works
